title: zarena
tagline: Zarena is a video livestream for decentralized communities for NFT drops
description: The project is a live streaming video platform for communities to showcase projects, specifically NFTs, where hosts create curated content for users to vote on. Users can vote on content, and a list of projects are  showcased in a feed for consumption. The platform uses zora zorbs to represent identities.
how_its_made: The project uses superfluid crypto streams in order to gate access to a content. The content is served via livepeer decentralized video. The project uses a centralized server to keep track of votes. The project uses a react front end where zora zorbs are used to represent the identity of members.
